title: Quebec's legislative session in limbo as court mandates oath to the King
description: A Quebec Superior Court judge has suspended the province’s law that made the oath to King Charles optional, ordering that members of the province's legislature must swear allegiance before sitting at the National Assembly. Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon said Monday he would refuse to take the oath, and that he would fight the ruling.
text:
A Quebec Superior Court judge has suspended the province’s law that made the oath to King Charles optional, ordering that members of the province's legislature must swear allegiance before sitting at the National Assembly. Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon said Monday he would refuse to take the oath, and that he would fight the ruling. A Quebec Superior Court judge has suspended the province’s law that made the oath to King Charles optional, ordering that members of the province's legislature must swear allegiance before sitting at the National Assembly.

Justice Ian Demers ruled Monday that the Quebec government overstepped its constitutional boundaries with its 2022 law. Demers warned that laws passed at the National Assembly could be rendered invalid if members do not take the oath. Quebec Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon, who has vowed to abolish the monarchy in Quebec, said his government will appeal the decision.

And I think we are dozens and maybe more than 100 elected members of parliament duly elected through a democratic process who think it's a disgrace." During the election campaign earlier this year, St-Pierre Plamondon said a PQ government would defund the office of Quebec's lieutenant-governor and would "abolish whatever monarchy exists in Quebec." Oath to King required for Quebec MNAs, court rules The leader of the Quebec Conservatives, as well as several former CAQ ministers, said the province should challenge the ruling.

ผู้พิพากษาไอแอน เดเมอร์ส ตัดสินใจในวันจันทร์ว่ารัฐบาลคิวเบก ละเมิดขอบเขตรัฐธรรมนูญด้วยกฎหมายปี 2022. เดเมอร์ส เตือนว่ากฎหมายที่ผ่านในสภาแห่งชาติ อาจถูกยกเลิก หากสมาชิกไม่สาบาน. พอล เซนต์เปียร์ พลามอนดอน นายกรัฐมนตรีคิวเบก ที่ได้สาบานยกเลิกการปกครองมหาอํานาจในคิวเบก.
